full_details: You did not go up at nine, and you did not go up at two. The tables already said that Thursday was Pope's. At dinner Mistress Ansell asked whether you were going, and you said you were not. You know he has the part. You do not know whether the yard laughed, or how full the house was. You did not send anyone to ask. At twenty past two you said Thomas had it, and that yesterday's custard had been good. The jaw is still tender. You ate what she set down. You are not well, and you did not call yourself well.
one_sentence: You stayed in the lodging all day, and at two Thomas had the king.
title: Stayed in while Thomas had the king
